narr: A terrain based afternoon thunderstorm developed over the McBride burn scar in the Sacramento Mountains near Ruidoso on July 9th. The slow movement of the storm allowed for a period of heavy rainfall over the burn scar to occur. Flash flooding was reported along Gavilan Canyon Road and Warrior Drive by emergency management. Thankfully there were no reports of casualties or injuries.
ev: Emergency management reported trees and rocks were carried by running water into the intersection of Gavilan Canyon Road and Warrior Drive. There were no reports of injuries, casualties, or damage to structures.
